# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Do not open a public issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Report privately through one of these channels:

- GitHub Security Advisories: https://github.com/[org]/[repo]/security/advisories/new
- Email: [security contact email]

Include a proof of concept or reproduction steps when possible.

## Response Timeline

- **Acknowledgement**: within [2] business days.
- **Initial assessment**: within [7] days.
- **Fix or mitigation plan**: within [30] days, depending on severity.

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| [x.y] (latest) | Yes |
| [x.y-1] | Security fixes only |
| < [x.y-1] | No |

## Disclosure Policy

We follow coordinated disclosure: fixes are released before any public
announcement, and reporters are credited in the release notes unless they
prefer to stay anonymous.
